🎮Gameplay behavior
How the app reacts while you play or review.
Auto-flip when playing Black
Orient the board to match your side. Off keeps White at the bottom.
Move notation style
How moves are written — e.g. Nf3 vs ♘f3.
Auto-show best-move arrow

Auto-advance on solve
Load the next puzzle automatically after solving one.

🧠Engine
On-device engine fallback
Uses your device's Stockfish engine when no cloud evaluation is cached.

Lower = faster eval. Higher = slower but more accurate.
